version.changelog: 飞书多 Agent 消息发送技能，支持群聊和私聊，完整文档和脚本

llm.summary: The skill generally does what it says (reads local agent Feishu credentials and sends messages via Feishu APIs), but it accesses local agent config and gateway logs (not declared) and prints message content — these behaviors could expose sensitive data and should be reviewed before installing.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (send Feishu messages as the current Agent) matches the code and instructions: the script and curl examples obtain an app token and POST to official open.feishu.cn endpoints to send messages. Reading the agent's Feishu appId/appSecret is necessary for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and send.sh read ~/.openclaw/openclaw-{agent}.json and suggest using journalctl to extract open_id from gateway logs. Those file/log reads are outside the registry's declared requirements and may expose sensitive data (app secrets, user messages) to the skill's output or other logs. The script also echoes message text to stdout which can be captured in shell/agent logs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec; no network downloads or packages are installed by the skill itself. That minimizes supply-chain risk. It does require curl/jq at runtime (documented in clawhub.yaml).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No env vars or config paths were declared in the registry metadata, but the runtime instructions and script legitimately require access to local config files containing app_secret and app_id. Requesting/reading those local credentials is proportionate to sending messages, but those are sensitive credentials and the skill should have made that explicit in its metadata.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or persistent platform-wide privileges. It will act with the invoking user's permissions and does not modify other skills' configs. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default but not a unique risk here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill uses the agent's Feishu appId/appSecret from ~/.openclaw/openclaw-{agent}.json and may read gateway logs to find open_id — those files contain sensitive credentials and user metadata. Before installing: 1) inspect the send.sh script yourself (it is included) and test locally with a throwaway account; 2) confirm you trust the skill owner and that the Feishu app secrets stored in your config are scoped/minimized; 3) be aware the script prints message text and other info to stdout (which may be captured in logs) — avoid sending secrets; 4) if you have concerns, keep this skill manual-only (don't allow autonomous invocation) or rotate the app_secret after testing. If you want a cleaner audit trail, consider modifying the script to avoid echoing message content and to explicitly declare required config paths in metadata.
